recipe.name: Home on time
recipe.hook_formula: Lead with being home: the home time the brief states (every night, weekends, so many days a month), in the reader's words. If the brief states no home time, lead with the schedule or the area that keeps the driver near home. The one fact that makes it believable goes on the second line, in a few words.
recipe.image_prompt_template: Our truck parked on a quiet {street} at {time_of_day}, a porch light on, {season}, {viewpoint}, no people, no text, no logos, no lettering

en.primary_text: Silvicom Inc runs reefer freight from Chicago to Texas. Regional lanes mean home weekly, with weekly pay on the same schedule. $0.64–$0.72 per mile, no-touch freight, dispatcher speaks Spanish. Must be 23+ with 2 years experience.
en.headline: Home every week.
